title: John Lynch on Nick Bosa's return: Calf injuries are sometimes murky

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Lynch on Nick Bosa's return: Calf injuries are sometimes murky
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa remains out with the calf injury that kept him from playing in Week 3 and a return date has remained unclear as the team prepares to face the Broncos this weekend.
